context_cardinality.coordinate_free_previous_relation: Use the previous ordered (recipient,donor) relation; under carrier permutations it transports relationally without binary label preference.
context_cardinality.proof: A continuation context sufficient for all three donor histories must distinguish X2,X3,X4 injectively; otherwise two histories requiring different next donors share a context and deterministic continuation fails.

two_boolean_bits.reason: One code is unused and the donor-to-code assignment is arbitrary without extra structure.

continuation_theorem: A nonempty fixed-recipient transfer sequence is rank-one iff exactly one donor branch occurs; therefore donor_(k+1)=donor_k.

rank_facts.theorem: For any nonempty sequence of fixed-recipient primitive transfers, the Z-rank of its displacement span equals the number of distinct donor branches used.
rank_facts.unimodular_minor: Rows X2,X3,X4 of columns t2,t3,t4 form diag(-1,-1,-1), determinant -1.

straightness_definition: STRAIGHT means the realized displacement vectors generate a rank-one integer submodule.
